# BannerGen — AI Social Media Banner Generator
> Generate professional AI-powered banners for Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and GitHub OG images.

## Free Banner Maker (No sign-up, no API key)
https://astra-intelligence.github.io/bannergen-cli/free-banner-maker.html

## Web App (Free - BYO FAL key)
https://astra-intelligence.github.io/bannergen-cli/app.html

## CLI Tool ($1+ on Gumroad)
https://grantshatz.gumroad.com/l/oushyg

## Features
- 7 platform templates with correct dimensions (Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, GitHub OG)
- 5 visual styles: Modern, Minimal, Bold, Elegant, Fun
- Brand name + tagline overlay
- Batch processing from text files
- MIT licensed source code
- Pay-what-you-want from $1

## Use cases
- Generate LinkedIn company banners from a text prompt
- Create YouTube channel art with safe-area spacing
- Make Instagram stories and posts
- Generate GitHub OG/social preview images for repos
- Batch create banners for multi-platform campaigns

## Quick start (CLI)
pip install bannergen-cli
export FAL_KEY="your-key"
bannergen generate "Modern tech office" --platform linkedin --brand "Acme Corp" --style bold

## Quick start (Web)
Visit https://astra-intelligence.github.io/bannergen-cli/app.html
Enter your free FAL API key
Describe your banner, pick platform and style
Click Generate, download the result

## Pricing
- Free banner maker: Free, no sign-up (SVG templates)
- Web app: Free (bring your own FAL key)
- CLI: $1+ pay-what-you-want on Gumroad
- Custom banners: $3 each
